probes.title: install uv + source (uv sync) + tlog-rec per-distro + ensure script/pkttyagent + pre-seed sandbox-ai.toml (separate-user, sudo auth for the bootstrap setup)
probes.command:
echo '== install uv =='; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; . "$HOME/.local/bin/env" 2>/dev/null || . "$HOME/.cargo/env" 2>/dev/null || true; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; uv --version || { echo PREP_UV_FAIL; exit 1; }; echo '== uploaded source tarball present? =='; TARBALL=$(ls "$HOME"/sandbox-ai-src*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$TARBALL" ] || { echo PREP_TARBALL_MISSING; exit 1; }; echo '== extract + uv sync =='; rm -rf "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; mkdir -p "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; tar -xzf "$TARBALL" -C "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; uv sync --directory "$HOME/sandbox-ai" 2>&1 | tail -6; "$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/sandbox" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_SANDBOX_INSTALLED_OK || { echo PREP_SANDBOX_INSTALL_FAIL; exit 1; }; echo '== install tlog-rec per-distro (best-effort; failure -> L0 refuses, which is a separate finding) =='; . /etc/os-release; if command -v tlog-rec >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'tlog-rec already present'; else ( case "${ID:-}" in ubuntu) sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y tlog ;; debian) maj=$(echo "${VERSION_ID:-0}" | cut -d. -f1); if [ "${maj:-0}" -le 12 ] 2>/dev/null; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y tlog; else echo "debian ${VERSION_ID}: source-building tlog"; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake libtool m4 pkg-config git libjson-c-dev libsystemd-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libutempter-dev; T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Scribery/tlog "$T/tlog"; cd "$T/tlog" && autoreconf -i -f && ./configure --prefix=/usr --sysconfdir=/etc --localstatedir=/var && make -j"$(nproc)" && sudo make install && sudo ldconfig; fi ;; fedora) sudo dnf -y install tlog ;; arch|manjaro) if command -v paru >/dev/null 2>&1; then paru -S --noconfirm tlog; elif command -v yay >/dev/null 2>&1; then yay -S --noconfirm tlog; else sudo pacman -Sy --needed --noconfirm base-devel git; T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth=1 https://aur.archlinux.org/yay.git "$T/yay"; cd "$T/yay" && makepkg -si --noconfirm && yay -S --noconfirm tlog; fi ;; esac ) || echo 'tlog install step returned non-zero'; fi; command -v tlog-rec >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_TLOG_OK || echo PREP_TLOG_MISSING_review; echo '== ensure script(1) + pkttyagent present (pkttyagent is load-bearing for the polkit start/attach best-effort) =='; command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_SCRIPT_OK || { echo 'installing util-linux/script'; ( case "${ID:-}" in ubuntu|debian) sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y bsdutils util-linux ;; fedora) sudo dnf -y install util-linux ;; arch|manjaro) sudo pacman -Sy --needed --noconfirm util-linux ;; esac ) >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_SCRIPT_OK || echo PREP_SCRIPT_MISSING_review; }; command -v pkttyagent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_PKTTYAGENT_OK || { echo 'installing polkit (pkttyagent)'; ( case "${ID:-}" in ubuntu|debian) sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y policykit-1 polkitd pkexec ;; fedora) sudo dnf -y install polkit ;; arch|manjaro) sudo pacman -Sy --needed --noconfirm polkit ;; esac ) >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v pkttyagent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_PKTTYAGENT_OK || echo PREP_PKTTYAGENT_MISSING_review; }; echo '== pre-seed per-operator sandbox-ai.toml: separate-user, sudo auth for the bootstrap setup (polkit-bypass-install flips it to polkit later) =='; mkdir -p "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config"; printf '[host]
docker_unprivileged_user = "sandbox"
machinectl_authentication = "sudo"
' > "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml"; cat "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml"; echo '== provenance =='; "$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/sandbox" --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'sandbox --version: n/a'; uname -r; systemctl --version | head -1; . /etc/os-release; echo "DISTRO=${ID:-?} VERSION_ID=${VERSION_ID:-?}"; echo PREP_PROVENANCE_review; echo PREP_TOML_SEEDED_OK
probes.classifies: PRE-REQ: the `sandbox` CLI via `uv sync` from the uploaded source tarball, tlog-rec per-distro (L0 hard prereq + attach session recorder), script(1)/pkttyagent present (pkttyagent load-bearing for the polkit best-effort), and a per-operator separate-user sandbox-ai.toml seeded sudo-auth for the bootstrap setup (flipped to polkit by polkit-bypass-install).

probes.title: `sudo sandbox setup --docker-execution-mode separate-user --machinectl-auth polkit --yes` MUST refuse (polkit not supported by setup)
probes.command: VENV="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin"; rc=0; echo '== attempt setup with --machinectl-auth polkit; EXPECT a refusal (exit != 0) =='; rm -f /tmp/setup_polkit_refused.out; sudo env PATH="$VENV:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin" sandbox setup --docker-execution-mode separate-user --machinectl-auth polkit --yes > /tmp/setup_polkit_refused.out 2>&1; RC=$?; echo "setup(polkit) exit: $RC (non-zero expected — a refusal)"; tail -30 /tmp/setup_polkit_refused.out; echo '== PRIMARY: a refusal was observed (exit != 0 AND the output mentions polkit / not supported / refused) =='; if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ] && grep -qiE 'polkit|not.*support|refus' /tmp/setup_polkit_refused.out; then echo POLKIT_SETUP_REFUSED_OK; else echo POLKIT_SETUP_NOT_REFUSED_FAIL; rc=1; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: Setup correctly REFUSES `--machinectl-auth polkit` (setup runs as root and crosses via sudo machinectl directly; polkit-auth provisioning is not supported). This probe PASSES when the refusal is observed (exit != 0 + a polkit/not-supported/refused message).

probes.title: bootstrap a working host: `sudo … script -qec 'sandbox setup --docker-execution-mode separate-user --docker-unprivileged-user sandbox --machinectl-auth sudo --yes'`
probes.command: VENV="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin"; rc=0; echo '== bootstrap the host in SUDO+separate-user so the polkit lifecycle has a converged host; capture the FULL tty with script(1) =='; rm -f /tmp/setup.out; sudo env PATH="$VENV:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin" script -qec "sandbox setup --docker-execution-mode separate-user --docker-unprivileged-user sandbox --machinectl-auth sudo --yes" /tmp/setup.out; RC=$?; echo "setup exit: $RC (0 expected)"; tail -30 /tmp/setup.out; [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && echo SETUP_EXIT0_OK || { echo SETUP_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; grep -qiE "Setup complete|Summary:.*0 failed" /tmp/setup.out && echo SETUP_COMPLETE_OK || { echo SETUP_NO_COMPLETE_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== setup-state marker present =='; if sudo test -f /usr/local/libexec/sandbox-ai/setup-state.json; then echo SETUP_MARKER_PRESENT_OK; else echo SETUP_MARKER_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; fi; echo '== dedicated sandbox daemon user exists =='; id sandbox >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo SETUP_SANDBOX_USER_OK || { echo SETUP_NO_SANDBOX_USER_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== sentinel guard: "Exit sentinel not found" must be ABSENT (EXPECTED to fire on the apt/debian-13 separate-user case; gated to record reality) =='; if grep -qiE "Exit sentinel not found" /tmp/setup.out; then echo SETUP_SENTINEL_PRESENT_FAIL; rc=1; else echo SETUP_NO_SENTINEL_OK; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: Provision a converged separate-user host in SUDO mode (the only mode setup supports) so the lifecycle has a host: exit 0 + 'Setup complete' + setup-state marker + the `sandbox` daemon user. Sentinel guard records reality (apt/debian-13 EXPECTED to trip).

probes.title: install the GENUINE polkit rule via the repo's renderer + start polkitd + flip the operator toml to polkit
probes.command:
export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; OP=$(id -un); PY="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/python3"; SRC="$HOME/sandbox-ai/src"; echo '== (a) ensure polkitd running =='; sudo systemctl enable --now polkit 2>/dev/null || sudo systemctl start polkit 2>/dev/null || sudo systemctl start polkitd 2>/dev/null || true; if systemctl is-active --quiet polkit 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-active --quiet polkitd 2>/dev/null; then echo POLKIT_DAEMON_RUNNING_OK; else echo POLKIT_DAEMON_NOT_RUNNING_review; systemctl status polkit 2>&1 | head -5 || true; fi; echo '== (b) render the GENUINE rule via core.setup.l3_sudoers_polkit.render_polkit_rule(operator, sandbox_user) and install it root-owned 0644 =='; rm -f /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered; PYTHONPATH="$SRC" "$PY" -c "from core.setup.l3_sudoers_polkit import render_polkit_rule; import sys; sys.stdout.write(render_polkit_rule('$OP','sandbox'))" > /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered 2>/tmp/polkit_rule.err; PRC=$?; if [ "$PRC" -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered ]; then echo POLKIT_RULE_RENDER_FAIL; rc=1; cat /tmp/polkit_rule.err; else echo '--- rendered polkit rule ---'; cat /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered; fi; DEST=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/49-sandbox-ai-machinectl.rules; if [ -s /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered ]; then sudo install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/polkit_rule.rendered "$DEST" && sudo test -f "$DEST" && echo POLKIT_RULE_INSTALLED_OK || { echo POLKIT_RULE_INSTALL_FAIL; rc=1; }; else echo POLKIT_RULE_INSTALL_FAIL; rc=1; fi; echo '== (c) flip the per-operator toml machinectl_authentication = polkit =='; printf '[host]
docker_unprivileged_user = "sandbox"
machinectl_authentication = "polkit"
' > "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml"; grep -q 'machinectl_authentication = "polkit"' "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml" && echo POLKIT_TOML_FLIPPED_OK || { echo POLKIT_TOML_FLIP_FAIL; rc=1; }; cat "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml"; exit $rc
probes.classifies: Polkit lifecycle setup (NOT the test itself): start polkitd, render the GENUINE action-level rule via the repo's own core.setup.l3_sudoers_polkit.render_polkit_rule(operator, 'sandbox'), install it to /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/49-sandbox-ai-machinectl.rules root:root 0644, and flip the operator toml to machinectl_authentication=polkit. PASSES if it managed to install + flip.

probes.title: `sandbox init smoke --empty main` + seed dummy secrets; instance dir present
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; echo '== init (non-TTY stdin) =='; sandbox init smoke --empty main < /dev/null > /tmp/init.out 2>&1; IRC=$?; echo "init exit: $IRC"; tail -20 /tmp/init.out; [ "$IRC" -eq 0 ] && echo INIT_EXIT0_OK || { echo INIT_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== seed dummy secrets so the start secret-completeness gate passes =='; ENVF="$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke/.sandbox.env"; if [ -f "$ENVF" ]; then sed -i 's#^CORE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.*#CORE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-dummy0000000000000000000000000000"#; s#^CORE_GITHUB_TOKEN=.*#CORE_GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummy00000000000000000000000000000000"#' "$ENVF" && echo INIT_SECRETS_SEEDED_OK; else echo INIT_NO_ENV_FILE_review; fi; echo '== assert instance dir present =='; if [ -d "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke" ]; then echo INIT_INSTANCE_DIR_PRESENT_OK; else echo INIT_INSTANCE_DIR_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox init smoke --empty main` -> exit 0 + instance dir created; dummy CORE secrets seeded for the start gate.

probes.title: `sandbox doctor --user sandbox --machinectl-auth polkit`: host readiness
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox doctor --user sandbox --machinectl-auth polkit > /tmp/doctor.out 2>&1; DRC=$?; echo "doctor exit: $DRC (0 expected)"; cat /tmp/doctor.out; [ "$DRC" -eq 0 ] && echo DOCTOR_EXIT0_OK || { echo DOCTOR_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; grep -qE '(✓|✗|⚠).*machinectl' /tmp/doctor.out && echo DOCTOR_ROW_MACHINECTL_PRESENT_review || echo DOCTOR_ROW_MACHINECTL_ABSENT_review; grep -qiE 'Privilege Boundary' /tmp/doctor.out && echo DOCTOR_PRIV_BOUNDARY_SECTION_review || true; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox doctor --user sandbox --machinectl-auth polkit` -> exit 0 on the polkit-flipped separate-user host (records whether doctor's headless polkit probes pass).

probes.title: `sandbox status smoke` while stopped
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox status smoke > /tmp/status_stopped.out 2>&1; SRC=$?; echo "status exit: $SRC"; tail -25 /tmp/status_stopped.out; [ "$SRC" -eq 0 ] && echo STATUS_STOPPED_EXIT0_OK || { echo STATUS_STOPPED_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox status smoke` (instance stopped) -> exit 0; observational baseline of the stopped-state report.

probes.title: `sandbox workspace list smoke --json` shows `main`
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace list smoke --json > /tmp/wslist1.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-list exit: $WRC"; cat /tmp/wslist1.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_LIST_1_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_LIST_1_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; grep -q 'main' /tmp/wslist1.out && echo WS_LIST_1_MAIN_PRESENT_OK || { echo WS_LIST_1_MAIN_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace list smoke --json` -> exit 0 + the seeded `main` workspace is listed.

probes.title: `sandbox workspace add smoke --empty dev`
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace add smoke --empty dev > /tmp/wsadd.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-add exit: $WRC"; tail -20 /tmp/wsadd.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_ADD_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_ADD_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; sandbox workspace list smoke --json > /tmp/wsadd_list.out 2>&1; grep -q 'dev' /tmp/wsadd_list.out && echo WS_ADD_DEV_PRESENT_OK || { echo WS_ADD_DEV_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; cat /tmp/wsadd_list.out; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace add smoke --empty dev` -> exit 0 + `dev` appears in the workspace listing (instance stopped).

probes.title: `sandbox workspace rename smoke dev dev2`
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace rename smoke dev dev2 > /tmp/wsrename.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-rename exit: $WRC"; tail -20 /tmp/wsrename.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_RENAME_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_RENAME_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; sandbox workspace list smoke --json > /tmp/wsrename_list.out 2>&1; grep -q 'dev2' /tmp/wsrename_list.out && echo WS_RENAME_DEV2_PRESENT_OK || { echo WS_RENAME_DEV2_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; cat /tmp/wsrename_list.out; }; if grep -qw 'dev' /tmp/wsrename_list.out; then echo WS_RENAME_OLD_DEV_REMAINS_FAIL; rc=1; else echo WS_RENAME_OLD_DEV_GONE_OK; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace rename smoke dev dev2` -> exit 0 + `dev2` present and `dev` gone from the listing.

probes.title: `sandbox start smoke --no-handover` (separate-user POLKIT): expect the headless polkit wall; best-effort pkttyagent attempt
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; echo '== start (polkit mode; the crossing likely hits the headless interactive-auth wall) =='; sandbox start smoke --no-handover > /tmp/start.out 2>&1; SRC=$?; echo "start exit: $SRC"; tail -30 /tmp/start.out; [ "$SRC" -eq 0 ] && echo START_EXIT0_OK || { echo START_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== crossing-error guard =='; if grep -qiE "Interactive authentication required|Exit sentinel not found|systemd error|failed to create task" /tmp/start.out; then echo START_CROSSING_ERROR_PRESENT_FAIL; rc=1; else echo START_NO_CROSSING_ERROR_OK; fi; if grep -qiE "Interactive authentication required" /tmp/start.out; then echo '== best-effort: retry start with a backgrounded pkttyagent for the session (NOT a hard gate) =='; if command -v pkttyagent >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid pkttyagent --process $$ >/tmp/pkttyagent.start.out 2>&1 & PKA=$!; sleep 1; sandbox start smoke --no-handover > /tmp/start.pkt.out 2>&1; SRC2=$?; kill "$PKA" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "start(pkttyagent) exit: $SRC2"; tail -20 /tmp/start.pkt.out; [ "$SRC2" -eq 0 ] && echo START_POLKIT_PKTTYAGENT_OK_info || echo START_POLKIT_PKTTYAGENT_FAILED_info; else echo START_POLKIT_PKTTYAGENT_ABSENT_info; fi; fi; echo '== assert CORE running under the sandbox daemon (cross to sandbox via machinectl, sudo path independent of the polkit auth mode) =='; CT=$(sudo machinectl shell -q sandbox@.host /bin/bash -lc 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock; docker ps --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo "sandbox containers:"; echo "$CT"; if echo "$CT" | grep -q -- '-smoke-core-1'; then echo START_CORE_RUNNING_OK; else echo START_CORE_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; fi; echo '== container health (non-gating; via machinectl crossing) =='; HS=$(sudo machinectl shell -q sandbox@.host /bin/bash -lc 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock; docker ps --filter name=-smoke-core-1 --format "{{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo "core status: $HS"; echo "$HS" | grep -qiE 'healthy|Up' && echo START_CORE_HEALTHY_review || echo START_CORE_HEALTH_UNKNOWN_review; echo '== crossing mechanism (non-gating) =='; sudo journalctl --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "machinectl|systemd-run|transient" | tail -15; grep -qiE "machinectl shell" /tmp/start.out 2>/dev/null && echo CROSSING_MECH_MACHINECTL_review || true; grep -qiE "systemd-run|--pipe|transient unit" /tmp/start.out 2>/dev/null && echo CROSSING_MECH_PIPE_review || true; echo '== F-063 crossing diagnostic (non-gating) =='; sudo loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | sed -n '1,20p'; sudo loginctl user-status sandbox 2>/dev/null | head -20; sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "New session|class|logged out|Removed session" | tail -25; if sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "user-light"; then echo CROSSING_CLASS_USER_LIGHT_review; elif sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "user-early"; then echo CROSSING_CLASS_USER_EARLY_review; else echo CROSSING_CLASS_UNKNOWN_review; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox start smoke --no-handover` in POLKIT mode: PRIMARY gate is exit 0 + core running (likely FAILs at the headless interactive-auth wall — that is the baseline finding). A best-effort backgrounded-pkttyagent retry is recorded as an _info token (never a hard gate).

probes.title: `sandbox status smoke --detailed` (running iff start succeeded)
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox status smoke --detailed > /tmp/status_running.out 2>&1; SRC=$?; echo "status exit: $SRC"; tail -30 /tmp/status_running.out; [ "$SRC" -eq 0 ] && echo STATUS_RUNNING_EXIT0_OK || { echo STATUS_RUNNING_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox status smoke --detailed` -> exit 0; observational baseline of the detailed report (running state depends on whether the polkit start succeeded).

probes.title: `sandbox attach smoke main` (separate-user POLKIT): drive PTY via script(1); best-effort pkttyagent
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ATTACH_SCRIPT_TOOL_OK || { echo ATTACH_SCRIPT_TOOL_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== confirm core running before attach (cross to sandbox) =='; CT=$(sudo machinectl shell -q sandbox@.host /bin/bash -lc 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo "$CT" | grep -q -- '-smoke-core-1' && echo ATTACH_PRECOND_CORE_RUNNING_OK || { echo ATTACH_PRECOND_CORE_NOT_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== drive sandbox attach in a PTY via script(1); a backgrounded pkttyagent attends the polkit prompt (best-effort) =='; rm -f /tmp/attach.ts; SBX="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/sandbox"; if command -v pkttyagent >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid pkttyagent --process $$ >/tmp/pkttyagent.attach.out 2>&1 & PKA=$!; echo ATTACH_POLKIT_PKTTYAGENT_STARTED_info; else PKA=; echo ATTACH_POLKIT_PKTTYAGENT_ABSENT_info; fi; { sleep 6; printf 'echo RWHOAMI=$(whoami); echo RPWD=$(pwd)\n'; sleep 3; printf 'exit\n'; sleep 1; } | timeout 90 script -qec "$SBX attach smoke main" /tmp/attach.ts > /dev/null 2>&1; ARC=$?; [ -n "$PKA" ] && kill "$PKA" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "attach exit: $ARC"; echo '--- attach typescript (tail) ---'; tail -25 /tmp/attach.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '== headless polkit wall observed in the typescript? (observational) =='; grep -aqiE 'Interactive authentication required' /tmp/attach.ts && echo ATTACH_POLKIT_WALL_PRESENT_info || echo ATTACH_POLKIT_WALL_ABSENT_info; echo '== PRIMARY: warm handover reached the agent shell in /workspaces/main =='; if grep -aq ':/workspaces/main' /tmp/attach.ts; then echo ATTACH_REACHED_WORKSPACE_OK; else echo ATTACH_REACHED_WORKSPACE_FAIL; rc=1; fi; echo '== SECONDARY (best-effort interactive drive) =='; grep -aq 'RWHOAMI=agent' /tmp/attach.ts && echo ATTACH_USER_AGENT_review || echo ATTACH_USER_review; grep -aq 'RPWD=/workspaces/main' /tmp/attach.ts && echo ATTACH_CMD_PWD_review || echo ATTACH_CMD_PWD_review; echo '== F-063 crossing diagnostic (non-gating) =='; sudo loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | sed -n '1,20p'; sudo loginctl user-status sandbox 2>/dev/null | head -20; sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "New session|class|logged out|Removed session" | tail -25; if sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "user-light"; then echo CROSSING_CLASS_USER_LIGHT_review; elif sudo journalctl -u systemd-logind --since '-120s' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "user-early"; then echo CROSSING_CLASS_USER_EARLY_review; else echo CROSSING_CLASS_UNKNOWN_review; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox attach smoke main` in POLKIT mode: PRIMARY gate is the agent shell prompt reaching /workspaces/main (likely FAILs at the headless polkit wall). A backgrounded pkttyagent attends the prompt best-effort; the wall presence and pkttyagent attempt are recorded as _info tokens.

probes.title: `sandbox stop smoke`: no smoke container after settle (verify via machinectl)
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox stop smoke > /tmp/stop.out 2>&1; STC=$?; echo "stop exit: $STC"; tail -15 /tmp/stop.out; [ "$STC" -eq 0 ] && echo STOP_EXIT0_OK || { echo STOP_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== assert no smoke container after stop (settle/retry up to ~30s) =='; GONE=0; for i in $(seq 1 15); do CT=$(sudo machinectl shell -q sandbox@.host /bin/bash -lc 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); if echo "$CT" | grep -q -- '-smoke-'; then sleep 2; else GONE=1; break; fi; done; if [ "$GONE" -eq 1 ]; then echo STOP_NO_CONTAINER_OK; else echo STOP_CONTAINER_STILL_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox stop smoke` -> exit 0 + no running `-smoke-` container under the sandbox daemon after a ~30s settle/retry loop.

probes.title: `sandbox workspace remove smoke dev2 --backup`
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace remove smoke dev2 --backup > /tmp/wsremove.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-remove exit: $WRC"; tail -20 /tmp/wsremove.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_REMOVE_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_REMOVE_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; sandbox workspace list smoke --no-backups --json > /tmp/wsremove_list.out 2>&1; if "$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/python3" -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/tmp/wsremove_list.out')); names=[w['name'] for w in d.get('workspaces',[])]; sys.exit(0 if 'dev2' not in names else 1)"; then echo WS_REMOVE_DEV2_GONE_OK; else echo WS_REMOVE_DEV2_REMAINS_FAIL; rc=1; cat /tmp/wsremove_list.out; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace remove smoke dev2 --backup` -> exit 0 + `dev2` gone from the ACTIVE workspaces (checked via --no-backups so the backup id containing 'dev2' does not false-positive; instance stopped; leaves a backup for restore).

probes.title: `sandbox workspace restore smoke dev2`
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace restore smoke dev2 > /tmp/wsrestore.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-restore exit: $WRC"; tail -20 /tmp/wsrestore.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_RESTORE_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_RESTORE_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; sandbox workspace list smoke --json > /tmp/wsrestore_list.out 2>&1; grep -q 'dev2' /tmp/wsrestore_list.out && echo WS_RESTORE_DEV2_PRESENT_OK || { echo WS_RESTORE_DEV2_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; cat /tmp/wsrestore_list.out; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace restore smoke dev2` -> exit 0 + `dev2` present again in the listing.

probes.title: `sandbox workspace list smoke --json` (post-restore observational)
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox workspace list smoke --json > /tmp/wslist2.out 2>&1; WRC=$?; echo "ws-list exit: $WRC"; cat /tmp/wslist2.out; [ "$WRC" -eq 0 ] && echo WS_LIST_2_EXIT0_OK || { echo WS_LIST_2_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox workspace list smoke --json` post-restore -> exit 0; observational snapshot of the final workspace set.

probes.title: `sandbox destroy smoke --force --backup-workspaces=none`: instance dir gone
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; sandbox destroy smoke --force --backup-workspaces=none > /tmp/destroy.out 2>&1; DRC=$?; echo "destroy exit: $DRC"; tail -15 /tmp/destroy.out; [ "$DRC" -eq 0 ] && echo DESTROY_EXIT0_OK || { echo DESTROY_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; }; echo '== assert instance dir gone =='; if [ -d "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke" ]; then echo DESTROY_INSTANCE_DIR_REMAINS_FAIL; rc=1; ls -la "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke" | tail -5; else echo DESTROY_INSTANCE_DIR_GONE_OK; fi; echo '== teardown leftovers (non-gating; via machinectl crossing) =='; LC=$(sudo machinectl shell -q sandbox@.host /bin/bash -lc 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/docker.sock; docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -c -- '-smoke-'); echo "leftover_containers=$LC"; [ "$LC" = 0 ] && echo DESTROY_NO_LEFTOVER_CONTAINERS_review || echo DESTROY_LEFTOVER_CONTAINERS_review; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox destroy smoke --force --backup-workspaces=none` -> exit 0 + the instance dir $HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke is removed.
